property.description: Detect DICOM A-RELEASE or A-ABORT PDU with unexpected length (should be exactly 4)

event.description: DICOM A-RELEASE/A-ABORT header with pdu_len != 4 (likely retyped PDU)
event.boolean_expression: ((ip.src != 0) && ((#em_is_dicom(meta.proto_hierarchy) == 1) && ((#em_pdu_hdr_check(ip.src, ip.dst, tcp.src_port, tcp.dest_port, tcp.seq_nb, tcp.p_payload, tcp.payload_len, dicom.pdu_type) == 1) && (#is_exist(dicom.pdu_type) >= 0))))
